rows.what_the_ink_shows: In crops/120_scan008_L1025_equivalence.jpg the author writes that the datum M_* is equivalent to the datum of a system (up to isomorphism), followed by (E,R,X mapped to |X|). The list in crops/120_scan008_L1025_conditions_abc.jpg specifies a category with finite inverse limits, a functor to sets exact on the left, and an object R with the stated embedding condition into powers of R. No faithful, conservative, or transportable qualifications appear in that list, nor an additional numbered image axiom. In crops/120_scan008_L1025_marginal_parts.jpg the separate diagonal margin note mentions moderate parts/subobjects and stability expressions f(A), f^{-1}(B), and Cartesian products; the source already represents that reminder. It is visually separate from conditions a), b), c).
rows.note: Written: the equivalence claim and the three listed data, with the functor described as exact à gauche. Leave the statement and marginal reminder unchanged. Condition c) also literally says tt objet de R in the source and scan; this review does not silently repair that wording. The requested refinement, quoted verbatim, is: "needs |.| faithful, conservative, transportable and an image axiom (subobjects of R^m stable under coordinate morphisms R^m -> R^n, i.e. categorical M1); M2-M4 follow from finite limits; whether M1 follows is open". Its additional hypotheses, claimed consequences M2–M4, and open status for M1 are carried as unproved mathematical background. The cited re-derivation/check event 120/008 was not independently reproduced. The existing marginal mention of image stability is acknowledged, without treating it as a proved or fully stated categorical image axiom.

source_context:
On trouve que la donnée d'un $\mathcal M_*$ est équivalente à la donnée d'un système (à isom. près)
\[
 (\mathcal E,R,X\mathrel{\mapstochar\relbar}|X|)
\]
de a) la catégorie $\mathcal E$ avec $\varprojlim$ finies

b) le foncteur $X\mathrel{\mapstochar\relbar}|X|$ $\mathcal E\mathbin{-}(\mathrm{Ens})$ exact à gauche

c) l'objet $R\in\operatorname{Ob}\mathcal E$ tel que tt objet de $R$ se plonge dans un $R^n$.

\margin{Introduire les parties modérées d'un espace modéré correspondant aux sous-objets dans $\operatorname{Esp}_{\mathcal M_*}$, les propriétés de stabilité $f(A)$, $f^{-1}(B)$, produits cartésiens.}
